units.source_text: 源氏听了这消息之后，好几次单独召唤右近。

en.t: After Genji heard this news, he summoned Ukon privately several times.

units.source_text: 对她说道：“既然如此，叫她到这里来住吧。

en.t: He said to her, "In that case, have her come and live here.

units.source_text: 多年来我每逢想起了她，总觉得可惜而又抱歉。

en.t: For many years, whenever I thought of her, I always felt regret and remorse.

units.source_text: 如今找到了，我真高兴！

en.t: Now that she has been found, I am truly glad!

units.source_text: 直到现在才找到，我也太不中用了。

en.t: That I only found her now shows how useless I have been.

units.source_text: 我们不须告知她父亲内大臣。

en.t: We need not inform her father, the Minister of the Interior.

units.source_text: 他家里子女众多，人丁嘈杂。

en.t: His household has many children and is full of bustle and noise.

units.source_text: 这个乡下来的无母之儿加入其中，反而痛苦。

en.t: For this motherless child from the countryside to join them would only make her suffer.

units.source_text: 我子女甚少，家中寂寞，对外只说我无意之中找到了一个亲生女儿。

en.t: I have very few children, and my house is lonely, so we can simply tell others that I happened to find a daughter of my own.

units.source_text: 我要好好地抚养她，教她变成风流公子们相思之的呢。”

en.t: I will raise her with great care and make her someone elegant young gentlemen will long for."

units.source_text: 右近听了这话，庆幸小姐有了出头之日，不胜欢喜，说道：“此事悉听尊便。

en.t: Hearing this, Ukon rejoiced that her young mistress now had a chance to rise in the world, and in her great happiness she said, "I leave this entirely to your judgment.

units.source_text: 内大臣处，只要您不泄露，谁会传过去呢？

en.t: As for the Minister of the Interior, if you do not reveal it, who would pass the news to him?

units.source_text: 但愿您把她看作不幸短命而死的夕颜夫人的替身，鼎力栽培她，

en.t: I only hope that you will regard her as a substitute for Lady Yugao, who sadly died so young, and do all you can to raise her well,

units.source_text: 那时您对夫人在天之灵，也可减轻罪愆了。”

en.t: and then your guilt toward the lady's spirit in heaven may also be lightened."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“这件事，你恨煞我了么？”

en.t: Genji said, "Did you hate me bitterly over that matter?"

units.source_text: 他一面苦笑，一面淌下眼泪来。

en.t: As he smiled bitterly, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 说道：“年来我常常想，我同她，真是一段空花泡影的因缘！

en.t: He said, "Over the years I have often thought that my bond with her was truly as fleeting as blossoms in the air and bubbles on water.

units.source_text: 聚居在这六条院里的人，没有一个像当年的夕颜那么受我怜爱。

en.t: Among all those who live here in the Rokujo estate, not one has been loved by me as tenderly as Yugao was then.

units.source_text: 许多人寿命很长，我就永不变心地爱护她们。

en.t: Many others have lived long lives, and I have continued to care for them without changing my heart.

units.source_text: 只有夕颜短命而死，使我只能把你右近当作她的遗念而爱护，真乃一大遗憾！

en.t: Only Yugao died young, leaving me able to cherish only you, Ukon, as a remembrance of her, and that is a great sorrow to me.

units.source_text: 我至今一直不忘记她。

en.t: Even now I have never forgotten her.

units.source_text: 倘得她的遗孤在我身边，我就如意称心了。”

en.t: If her orphaned child could be by my side, my wish would be fulfilled."

units.source_text: 他就写信给玉鬘。

en.t: He then wrote a letter to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 因为他想起了末摘花的生涯潦倒，不知玉鬘在沉沦中长大，人品究竟如何，

en.t: Because he remembered how Suetsumuhana had fallen into hardship, he did not know what Tamakazura's character might be like after growing up in such reduced circumstances,

units.source_text: 所以想看看她的回信。

en.t: and so he wanted to see her reply.

units.source_text: 他给玉鬘的信语气尊严，一似父亲。

en.t: The letter he sent to Tamakazura was dignified in tone, just like that of a father.

units.source_text: 末了写道：

en.t: At the end, he wrote:
